direct_comparator_mapping.mapping: identity string match; no semantic translation

BETH_P0.construction: Frozen BETH action vocabulary applied unchanged by exact syscall-name match.

BETH_P1.construction: Frozen BETH action and predecessor vocabulary applied unchanged by exact syscall-name match.

LIDDS_P0.construction: Top training-normal syscall names with support >=20; default deny.

LIDDS_P1.construction: Top training-normal syscalls with support >=20; each allowed action requires one of up to k most frequent supported immediate same-thread predecessors; default deny.

policy_design.calibration_labels: recording-level NORMAL metadata only; no syscall-level attack labels
policy_design.event_rows: completed syscall exits (<), one row per invocation; timestamps retained in nanoseconds
policy_design.history_partition: within recording by (process_id, thread_id); original line order; no cross-recording history
policy_design.malformed_and_unpaired_lines: counted and reported; unmatched exits are retained as completed invocations at capture boundaries
policy_design.selection: maximize completed validation events accepted subject to <=1% validation-normal event alert fraction; tie-break on fewer rules, smaller allowlist, then fewer predecessors
policy_design.split_protocol_note: Test folder names were visible during central-directory inspection; test JSON metadata and syscall streams were not read before this freeze.
policy_design.training_population: NORMAL recordings only; IDLE excluded; no attack recording contributes to policy
